_comment: NOT IN USE AND STALE. tefillah.in is served from S3 + CloudFront; the live security headers are set on the CloudFront distribution (E20DJ1IDF5M5MD), not here. The CSP below is narrower than production and omits identitytoolkit / securetoken / firebaseapp.com, so Google and Apple sign-in would both fail under it. If the site ever moves to Vercel, sync this against `curl -I https://tefillah.in/login` first.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data: blob:; connect-src 'self' https://api.tefillah.in; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'
